definitions.explanation: The freezing compartment of a refrigerator, or a standalone freezer unit. Used for storing frozen food and making ice.

examples.japanese: {冷凍室|れいとうしつ}に{入|い}れておいて。
{冷凍室|れいとうしつ}がいっぱいになった。
{肉|にく}を{冷凍室|れいとうしつ}から{出|だ}して{解凍|かいとう}してください。
examples.english: Please take the meat out of the freezer and defrost it.

notes:
Compound of {冷凍|れいとう} (freezing) and {室|しつ} (room, compartment). Refers to either the freezer section of a household refrigerator or a commercial/industrial freezer room.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {冷凍室|れいとうしつ}に{入|い}れる: to put in the freezer
- {冷凍室|れいとうしつ}から{出|だ}す: to take out of the freezer
- {冷凍室|れいとうしつ}の{温度|おんど}: freezer temperature
- {冷凍室|れいとうしつ}の{整理|せいり}: organizing the freezer

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {冷凍庫|れいとうこ}: freezer — essentially the same meaning; {冷凍庫|れいとうこ} is more common in everyday speech for standalone freezers
- {冷蔵室|れいぞうしつ}: refrigerator compartment — the chilled (not frozen) section of a fridge
- {冷蔵庫|れいぞうこ}: refrigerator — the entire appliance including both fridge and freezer sections
